author: NitroPlaysYT
body:
ING: JHP_
Reason for ban: Team Killing
I should be unbanned as: 1. DeciduousRukii was not online 2. He has no evidence 3. It was another player team killing me!


I was on walls and i put some iron ore in a furnace. Then my teammate destroyed the furnace and threw the iron in lava. I then told him to go away, he said no and put lava on me, luckily i had a fire resistance potion active and didn't die. I put down some TNT and told him to go away or i would set it alight. Then he sets the TNT on fire and hits himself to 3 hearts, afterwards he set himself on fire with lava and me as well. We both died and said sorry to each other.


Please consider my appeal.
